name: Sesame-Panko Edamame Fritters with Spicy Mayo & Tahini Dressed Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place edamame in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; drain and place in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and mince onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the edamame.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Add flour, eggs, salt, pepper to the bowl, then using a fork, stir until well combined. (The batter will be soft and sticky.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup all-purpose flour
6 eggs
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place bread crumbs and sesame seeds on a large baking sheet pan. Stir to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cup panko bread crumbs
3 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: Using a ¼-cup measure, drop edamame batter onto the baking sheet with the bread crumbs. Gently roll each scoop of batter in the crumbs to coat.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.

Working in batches, using a spatula, transfer batter to the skillet, spacing the scoops a few inches apart. Use the spatula to press down on the batter to form round fritters. Cook, flipping once, until golden brown, 3-5 minutes. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, place mayo and chili-garlic sauce in a clean small bowl. Whisk to combine the spicy mayo and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tbsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger; place in a clean large bowl. Add tahini, vinegar, soy sauce, oil, and chili-garlic sauce. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp tahini
3 tbsp rice vinegar
3 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumbers and add to the bowl.
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Top with edamame fritters and drizzle with spicy mayo. Enjoy!
